name: BOTTRAIN-Train
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
env:
  TRAIN_GAMES: '30'
  TRAIN_PLAYOUT: '200'
jobs:
  train-model:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install deps
        run: pip install numpy
      - name: Train model via self-play
        run: python3 train_bottrain.py
      - name: Commit & push model
        run: |
          git config user.name "bottrain-bot"
          git config user.email "bottrain@caro.ai"
          git add bottrain_model.npy bottrain_data/
          git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m "[bottrain] Train: $(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M)" && git push)
